title: Podcast Queue Snapshot Episodes Queued Leaderboard
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=podcast:queue episodes_queued=*
| stats sum(episodes_queued) as total_value, avg(episodes_queued) as avg_value by queue_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks queue values by total and average episodes queued across podcast queue snapshot events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `episodes_queued` values for each podcast queue snapshot event and review total and average episodes queued by queue.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total episodes queued.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which queue shows the biggest episodes queued numbers in your podcast queue snapshot data.
